spec.description: Dane zbierane z REST API Barracuda CloudGen Firewall przez Zabbix (itemy z tagiem type:API).

spec.rawSql: select h.host as "Host", regexp_replace(i.name, '^Box status ', '') as "Check", (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as "State" from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type = 4 and i.key_ like 'cgf%' and (i.name like 'Box status %' or i.name = 'Root disk state' or i.name ~ '^Service .* state$') order by 1, 2

select h.host as "Host", regexp_replace(i.name, '^Host ', '') as "Property", (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as "Value" from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type = 4 and i.key_ like 'cgf_box%' and i.name in ('Host appliance','Host hostname','Host hypervisor','Host model','Host release','Host timezone') order by 1, 2

spec.title: Site-to-Site Tunnels
spec.description: Jeden wiersz na tunel. Family state i Threads (aktywne / wszystkie) dotyczą całej rodziny tuneli; Status i Sessions konkretnego tunelu.

spec.rawSql: with raw as (select h.host, i.name, substring(i.key_ from '\["(.*)"\]') as k, substring(i.name from ': (.*)$') as attr, case when i.value_type = 4 then (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) else (select hu.value::text from history_uint hu where hu.itemid = i.itemid order by hu.clock desc limit 1) end as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type in (3,4) and i.key_ like 'cgf_vpn.s2s.%' and i.key_ not like 'cgf_vpn.s2s.health.%' and i.name like 'S2S tunnel %'), t as (select host, k, split_part(k, ':', 1) as fam, max(substring(name from '^S2S tunnel (.*): ')) as tunnel, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Status') as status, (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Sessions'))::int as sessions, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Peer address') as peer, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Local address') as loc, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Encryption') as enc, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Authentication') as auth, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Transport') as transport, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Type') as typ from raw where name not like 'S2S tunnel family %' group by host, k), f as (select host, k as fam, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Aggregate state') as fstate, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Threads active') as act, max(val) filter (where attr like 'Threads total%') as tot from raw where name like 'S2S tunnel family %' group by host, k) select t.host as "Host", t.fam as "Family", f.fstate as "Family state", f.act || ' / ' || f.tot as "Threads", t.tunnel as "Tunnel", t.status as "Status", t.sessions as "Sessions", t.peer as "Peer", t.loc as "Local", t.enc as "Encryption", t.auth as "Auth", t.transport as "Transport", t.typ as "Type" from t left join f on f.host = t.host and f.fam = t.fam order by 1, 2, 5

with v as (select h.host, substring(i.name from '^Interface (.*): ') as ifname, substring(i.name from ': (.*)$') as attr, (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type = 4 and i.key_ like 'cgf_if.%' and substring(i.name from '^Interface (.*): ') in ($Interface)) select host as "Host", ifname as "Interface", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Link state') as "Link", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Interface type') as "Type", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Duplex mode') as "Duplex", max(val) filter (where attr = 'Link negotiation') as "Negotiation" from v group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

spec.title: Firewall total throughput: packets per second
spec.description: UWAGA: wartość zawyżona, dopóki suma zawiera pola packets dla local i loopback (API zwraca w nich te same liczby co w bps).

item.filter: Firewall total throughput: packets per second

spec.title: Firewall sessions total
spec.description: body.total z /firewall/v1/live. Gdy lista połączeń jest obcięta (item 'Firewall connection list truncated' = 1), wartość zatrzymuje się na limicie zapytania (1000).

spec.title: VPN user connections observed (5m)
spec.description: Liczba rekordów połączeń użytkowników VPN z ostatnich 5 minut. To okno czasowe, nie dokładny licznik aktywnych użytkowników.

spec.rawSql: with v as (select h.host, case when i.key_ like 'cgf_disk_root%' then '/' else substring(i.name from '^Filesystem (.*): ') end as fs, case when i.key_ = 'cgf_disk_root_state' then 'State' when i.key_ = 'cgf_disk_root_free' then 'Free space' else substring(i.name from ': (.*)$') end as attr, case i.value_type when 4 then (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) when 3 then (select hu.value::text from history_uint hu where hu.itemid = i.itemid order by hu.clock desc limit 1) else (select round(hf.value::numeric)::text from history hf where hf.itemid = i.itemid order by hf.clock desc limit 1) end as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.value_type in (0,3,4) and (i.key_ like 'cgf_disk.%' or i.key_ like 'cgf_disk_root%')) select host as "Host", fs as "Mountpoint", max(val) filter (where attr = 'State') as "State", (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Free space'))::bigint as "Free space", (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Free inodes'))::bigint as "Free inodes" from v group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

spec.title: Licenses
spec.description: Jeden wiersz na licencję. Days left to najbliższa data wśród jej modułów; State pokazuje stan inny niż ok, jeśli ma go którykolwiek moduł. Moduły bez danych są pominięte.

spec.rawSql: with v as (select h.host, substring(i.name from '^License (.*): [^:]+$') as nm, substring(i.name from ': ([^:]+)$') as attr, case i.value_type when 4 then (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) else (select round(hf.value::numeric)::text from history hf where hf.itemid = i.itemid order by hf.clock desc limit 1) end as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags = 4 and i.value_type in (0,4) and i.key_ like 'cgf_license.%'), m as (select host, coalesce(substring(nm from '^[0-9]+-[A-Za-z]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+-(.*)-[0-9]+(?: \[.*\])?$'), regexp_replace(nm, ' \[.*\]$', '')) as product, max(val) filter (where attr = 'State') as st, max(val) filter (where attr = 'Status') as stt, (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Days until expiry'))::bigint as days from v group by host, nm having (max(val) filter (where attr = 'Days until expiry'))::bigint < 99999) select host as "Host", product as "Product", coalesce(max(st) filter (where st <> 'ok'), 'ok') as "State", string_agg(distinct stt, ', ') as "Status", min(days) as "Days left" from m group by host, product order by 5, 1, 2

spec.title: Tunnel packets per sample window
spec.description: Suma pakietów z próbek zwróconych przez API w jednym odczycie (co 5 min); to nie jest prędkość na sekundę.

spec.title: Tunnel bytes per sample window (API units)
spec.description: Suma pola m_iBytes* z próbek w jednym odczycie. Jednostka niepewna: stosunek do liczby pakietów (ok. 10 na pakiet) nie pasuje do bajtów.

spec.title: Tunnel drops per sample window
spec.description: Suma dropów z próbek zwróconych przez API w jednym odczycie (co 5 min).

spec.title: Bandwidth detection: local
spec.description: Ostatnia wartość m_llEffBW2Local per tunel (wartość surowa z API, jednostka nieopisana).

spec.title: Bandwidth detection: peer
spec.description: Ostatnia wartość m_llEffBW2Peer per tunel (wartość surowa z API, jednostka nieopisana).

spec.title: Tunnel latency
spec.description: Średnia z próbek health zwróconych przez API w jednym odczycie (co 5 min). Jednostka w API nieopisana; przyjęte milisekundy. Linie: 50 ms i 150 ms.

spec.title: Bandwidth detection over time (local / peer)
spec.description: Pola m_llEffBW2Local i m_llEffBW2Peer z próbek health (wartości surowe z API, jednostka nieopisana). Linia ciągła: local, przerywana: peer.

spec.title: Latency now
spec.description: Ostatnia wartość latency per tunel. Skala 0–200 ms; zielony poniżej 50 ms, pomarańczowy 50–150 ms, czerwony powyżej.

spec.title: S2S tunnels down
spec.description: Liczba tuneli S2S, których stan zbiorczy (Aggregate state) to DOWN, czyli nie działa żaden aktywny transport. Tunel z częścią transportów w dół (DEGRADED) nie jest liczony.

spec.rawSql: select count(*) filter (where upper(val) = 'DOWN') as "down" from (select (select ht.value from history_text ht where ht.itemid = i.itemid order by ht.clock desc limit 1) as val from items i join hosts h on h.hostid = i.hostid where h.host in ($Hostname) and h.status = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.flags in (0,4) and i.key_ like 'cgf_vpn.s2s.aggregate_state%') v
